items.headline: UKMTO 217-26: tanker incident with 'military forces' in Gulf of Oman near Chabahar
bullets: UKMTO advisory 217-26, posted 15:56 UTC Sunday: a company security officer reported a tanker involved in an incident with 'military forces' in the Gulf of Oman near Chabahar; incident time 14:25 UTC. No vessel named, no damage or casualties reported.

Location and timing line up with where an Iranian tanker would be if it sailed from Kharg Island on Sunday morning to test the US blockade — but UKMTO did not say which military party was involved, and no wire has confirmed a US interception.

Context: Iran's navy said Sunday two supertankers hit mines east of Hormuz (unverified); Tehran has threatened a 'fierce' response to any US stop of its tankers. Brent still at Friday's $92.59 close — futures reopen Sunday night; watch the open.

items.headline: NYT: US/Israel drew up post-midterm Iran strike plans; Houthi strikes kill at Dammam airport and Shaybah oilfield

FinCEN issued its first-ever admin subpoena under 31 USC 5318(k) probing a Greek bank's Iran ties, plus info requests to six other European banks over Iran-linked relationships.
Still the enforcement lane, not the strike lane: Reuters notes Washington has 'held off striking Iran this month' and is running the blockade + sanction waves instead — oil price reaction nil so far.
